goal: Set up the claude/ handoff system: machine-readable project facts, per-session handoff records, merge-conflict playbook, auto-loaded at session start.
summary: Added claude/ (README protocol, project.json, conflicts.json, session schema, session-start.mjs briefing, new-session.mjs), root CLAUDE.md importing AGENTS.md + claude/README.md, committed .claude/settings.json with a SessionStart hook, un-ignored that one file, and documented it in README.md. Also wrote a reconstructed record for the uncommitted color work. Committed on chore/claude-handoff (worktree ../momo-claude-handoff, based on origin/main) separately from the staged color work, PR to main.

decisions.why: .gitignore ignored /.claude/ as local preview config; handoff data must be committed and shared across teammates' instances.

decisions.what: One JSON file per session instead of a shared log
decisions.why: Per-session files never conflict across parallel branches.

decisions.what: Briefing reads session files from every local and remote-tracking branch via git show
decisions.why: Instances on other branches can see each other's claims without merging first.
Keeps session start fast and offline-safe; it prints the last fetch age instead.

verification.typecheck: pass before these changes; no TS changed
verification.manual: ran node claude/session-start.mjs and new-session.mjs; JSON files parse
